title: lophochloa pumila
intro: Lophochloa pumila, commonly known as Indian sarsaparilla, is a perennial plant species in the family Aristolochiaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Lophochloa pumila include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Lophochloa pumila include aristolochic acid, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and antiproliferative activities.
